headline: Malaysia Regulator Reviews Datasonic Group Trading Following Sharp Share Surge
summary: The Securities Commission Malaysia is auditing trading documentation to determine whether regulatory intervention is warranted following volatile price swings in Datasonic Group shares.
why: Datasonic Group is a major Malaysian ICT solutions provider specializing in national security ID card and passport issuance systems.

impacts.name: Datasonic Group Bhd
impacts.why: Regulatory review into share trading history creates short-term trading scrutiny.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
